topic: Unlocking Conic Sections: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres
target_audience: High school geometry or early undergraduate students

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Plane-Cone Intersection
lecture_lines: A double-napped cone meets a flat plane.
Tilting the plane creates different conic shapes.
Circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas emerge.
animations: Create a vertical cone in #FFFFFF color using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg].
Display a plane intersecting the cone at an angle.
Highlight the intersection curve in #FF00FF color.
Rotate the view to show the circular cross-section.
Fade out the plane and cone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg] for clarity.

sections.title: Introducing the Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres fit perfectly inside the cone.
They touch both the cone and plane.
Tangency points reveal deep geometric secrets.
animations: Place a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg] and a plane in the scene.
Animate two [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] tangent to both plane and cone.
Label spheres as 'Dandelin Spheres' in #FFFF00 color.
Show tangency points clearly in #00FFFF color.
Connect sphere centers with a line segment.

sections.title: The Geometry of the Ellipse
lecture_lines: Two spheres define the ellipse's foci.
Points of tangency mark the focal spots.
Distance sums stay constant for any point.
This defines the elegant ellipse structure.
Geometry connects points to simple curves.
animations: Display an ellipse formed by the intersection using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] to represent the intersecting 3D object.
Highlight the two tangency points on the ellipse.
Draw lines from foci to a point on ellipse.
Show the sum of focal distances is constant.
Color the ellipse #FF4500 and label axes using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] as a reference point for the coordinate system.

sections.title: Generalizing to Parabola and Hyperbola
lecture_lines: Parabolas need only one tangent sphere.
Hyperbolas place spheres in different nappes.
animations: Show plane intersecting one nappe for a parabola.
Highlight the parabolic curve in #32CD32 color.
Show plane parallel to the cone's side generator [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg].
Adjust plane for a hyperbola intersecting both nappes.
Highlight the hyperbolic branches in #1E90FF color [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Satellite dishes utilize these precise properties.
Planetary orbits follow these geometric laws.
